name: commie-doge
title: Commie Doge
author: xrisk
description: Reskins the engineer as a comrade Shiba ('doge'): a full 8-direction animated waddle, a curled tail, a player-colored cap with a gold star and hammer & sickle, a green toy water pistol when armed, and a gold hammer & sickle swung while mining -- now with cast shadows and directional aim while running and gunning. Optional doge-speak toasts narrate your factory ('much science. very five-year-plan. wow.'), toggleable per player in mod settings. The cap fill and chest take your chosen player color; the insignia stays gold. Overwrites the character, so enable only one character skin at a time.
